Any time you take damage while the ward has hit points, the ward takes the damage instead. If damage reduces the ward to 0 hit points, any leftover damage carries over to you. While the ward has 0 hit points, it can't absorb damage, but its magic remains. Whenever you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, the ward regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level. Once you create the ward, you can't create another until you finish a long rest.

name: Projected Ward
description: When a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to cause your Arcane Ward to absorb that damage. If this reduces the ward to 0 hit points, any remaining damage is taken by the creature.

name: Improved Abjuration
description: Whenever you cast an abjuration spell that requires you to make an ability check as part of casting that spell (such as counterspell against a higher-level spell), you add your proficiency bonus to that ability check.

name: Spell Resistance
description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells, and resistance against the damage of spells.

name: Ear for Deceit
description: Any time you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.
source: Inquisitive (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

name: Eye for Detail
description: You can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.
source: Inquisitive (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

name: Insightful Fighting
description: As a bonus action, make a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by a creature's Charisma (Deception) check to size it up in combat. If you succeed, you can use Sneak Attack against that creature without needing advantage, as long as it isn't incapacitated, until the end of your next turn.
source: Inquisitive (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

name: Steady Eye
description: You have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check if you moved no more than half your speed on the same turn.
source: Inquisitive (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 9th level.

name: Unerring Eye
description: As an action, you can sense whether a creature within 30 feet is disguising or concealing itself magically, or is a shapechanger, though not the specific nature of the disguise or concealment. Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regained on a long rest.
source: Inquisitive (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 13th level.

name: Eye for Weakness
description: Your Sneak Attack deals an extra 3d6 damage against any creature you have successfully sized up with Insightful Fighting.
source: Inquisitive (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 17th level.

name: Panache
description: As an action, make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Wisdom (Insight) check. If the target is hostile, on a success it has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you, and can't make opportunity attacks against anyone but you, until the end of your next turn. If the target isn't hostile, on a success it's charmed by you for 1 minute or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it.
source: Swashbuckler (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 9th level.

name: Elegant Maneuver
description: As a bonus action, gain advantage on the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make this turn.
source: Swashbuckler (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 13th level.

name: Master Duelist
description: When you miss with an attack roll, you can roll it again with advantage. Once used, you can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.
source: Swashbuckler (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 17th level.

name: Extra Attack (Bladesinger)
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. In addition, when you use your action to cast a Bladesinger cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
source: Bladesinger (Wizard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 6th level.

name: Song of Defense
description: While your Bladesong is active, you can use your reaction to expend a spell slot and reduce damage you take by an amount equal to five times the level of the spell slot expended.
source: Bladesinger (Wizard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 10th level.

name: Song of Victory
description: While your Bladesong is active, you add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to the damage of your melee weapon attacks.
source: Bladesinger (Wizard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 14th level.

name: Mystical Connection
description: When you roll on the Spirit Tales table, you can roll twice and choose which of the two results to use. If both rolls come up the same, you can instead choose any effect on the table.
source: College of Spirits (Bard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 14th level.

name: Primal Surge
description: While in Wild Shape, expend 1 charge from the Staff of the Wild's Balance as a bonus action: the next attack made this turn has advantage and deals an extra 1d6 damage on a hit.
note: Granted by Therynv'l's Staff of the Wild's Balance (party_items.json) — the charge pool is the staff's own (6 charges max, regains 1d6 charges daily), not an independent character resource.
source: Homebrew, unique to Therynv'l — tied to the Staff of the Wild's Balance.

name: Psionic Reinforcement
description: Passive +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with Psychic Blades (Soulknife).
note: Granted by Torrin's Weaver's Master-Awl (party_items.json), one of its four properties.
source: Homebrew, unique to Torrin — tied to the Weaver's Master-Awl.

name: Stormbreak Reserve
description: As a bonus action, release a stored charge: a 10ft radius force burst centered on self deals 2d6 force damage (DC 15 DEX save for half) to all other creatures in range, pushing each creature that fails 10ft away. The armor stores one charge (max 1) automatically whenever the wearer takes 15 or more damage from a single attack or effect.
note: Granted by Eldi's Breastplate of the Broken Scale (party_items.json) — the charge is the armor's own, gained by taking a big hit rather than on a rest.
source: Homebrew, unique to Eldi — tied to the Breastplate of the Broken Scale.

name: Sundering Strike
description: Once per short rest, as part of a melee attack that hits, channel the gauntlet: the attack deals an additional 2d6 damage, and the target's AC is reduced by 2 until the end of the wearer's next turn.
note: Granted by Eldi's Gauntlet of the Sundering Blow (party_items.json) — no separate action, just a decision made mid-attack.
source: Homebrew, unique to Eldi — tied to the Gauntlet of the Sundering Blow.

name: Warding Press
description: Once per long rest, press the ring to your skin to gain resistance to one damage type of your choice for 1 hour.
note: Granted by Rith's Signet Ring (party_items.json).
source: Homebrew, unique to Rith — tied to the Signet Ring.

name: Swift Strike
description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee attack, you may make one off-hand attack as a reaction.
note: Granted by Vaz's Bracer of Swift Strikes (party_items.json).
source: Homebrew, unique to Vaz — tied to the Bracer of Swift Strikes.

name: Missile Snaring
description: Reaction when hit by a ranged attack: reduce the damage by 1d10 + DEX modifier. If the damage is reduced to 0, catch the missile instead of being hit.
note: Granted by Therynv'l's Gloves of Missile Snaring (party_items.json) — matches the real 5e item's actual ability name.
source: Gloves of Missile Snaring (real 5e magic item).

name: Steadfast Response
description: Reaction when an ally within 30ft drops to 0hp: grant them 1d8 + proficiency bonus temporary HP, and they gain advantage on death saving throws.
note: Granted by Sorra's The Steadfast (party_items.json).
source: Homebrew, unique to Sorra — tied to The Steadfast.

name: Seize the Opening
description: Once per day, when the wearer does something that genuinely surprises an enemy, gain advantage on their next attack roll.
note: Granted by Ferghus's Helm of Carix (party_items.json) — triggers on a narrative surprise, not a chosen action, so it's not tagged with an action cost.
source: Homebrew, unique to Ferghus — tied to the Helm of Carix.

name: Reaching Hand
description: Once per day as a reaction when an ally within 30ft makes a death saving throw, grant them advantage on it.
note: Granted by Revven's Helm of the Reaching Hand (party_items.json).
source: Homebrew, unique to Revven — tied to the Helm of the Reaching Hand.

name: Tidal Surge
description: When the wearer casts a spell dealing cold, lightning, or thunder damage, add 2d6 of the same damage type, once per turn.
note: Granted by the Robe of the Tide (party_items.json) — currently unassigned/held by the party.
source: Homebrew — tied to the Robe of the Tide.

name: Ring's Answer
description: Once per day, gain a responsive bonus to an ability check or skill check.
note: Granted by The Farreach (A) and (B) (party_items.json) — a paired-ring set worn by Siv and Pirra respectively; each ring grants its own bearer this once-per-day use.
source: Homebrew, unique to Siv/Pirra — tied to the paired Farreach rings.

name: Fast Hands
description: Use the bonus action granted by Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, disarm/pick a lock or trap, or use thieves' tools to disarm a trap or pick a lock, in addition to Dash/Disengage/Hide.

name: Second-Story Work
description: Climbing no longer costs extra movement. When you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

name: Supreme Sneak
description: Advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

name: Use Magic Device
description: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

name: Thief's Reflexes
description: Take two turns during the first round of any combat: one at your normal initiative, and a second at your initiative minus 10 (rolling separate initiative isn't needed). Can't be used while surprised.

name: Skirmisher
description: Reaction: when a creature you can see moves to a space within 5 feet of you, move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature.

name: Survivalist
description: Gain proficiency in Nature and Survival if you don't already have it, and your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using either skill (effectively expertise in both).

name: Superior Mobility
description: Walking speed increases by 10 feet. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, it increases by the same amount.

name: Ambush Master
description: Advantage on initiative rolls. The first creature you hit during combat before any of your allies have taken a turn is easier for your allies to hit: attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of your next turn.

name: Sudden Strike
description: If you take the Attack action on your turn, make one additional attack as a bonus action. This attack can be a Sneak Attack even if you already used Sneak Attack this turn, but you can't Sneak Attack the same target twice in one turn.

name: Whispers of the Dead
description: After a short or long rest, gain proficiency in one skill (Athletics, Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Religion, or Stealth) or one tool/instrument you don't already have, borrowed from a spirit — swappable at your next rest.

name: Wails from the Grave
description: Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, also deal necrotic damage equal to half your Sneak Attack dice (rounded up) to a second creature within 30 feet of the original target. Usable a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Tokens of the Departed
description: Reaction, when a creature you can see dies within 30 feet: create a spectral token of its soul. Consuming a token grants advantage on a death save or a CON save to maintain concentration, fuels an extra use of Wails from the Grave, or lets you ask the departed spirit one question it would have answered honestly in life.

name: Ghost Walk
description: Bonus action: become spectral for up to 10 minutes — gain a 10ft flying speed, hover, advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, can't be heard unless you wish it, and can move through creatures/objects as difficult terrain (1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside one). Once per long rest, or by spending a token from Tokens of the Departed.

name: Death's Friend
description: Wails from the Grave now deals its necrotic damage to both the original Sneak Attack target and the second creature. If you have no tokens from Tokens of the Departed at the end of a long rest, automatically gain one.

name: Spellcasting (Eldritch Knight)
description: Cast wizard spells using INT, learned from the Wizard spell list (2 cantrips, then more per the class table). Most learned spells must be Abjuration or Evocation — spells picked at 8th, 14th, and 20th level can be from any school. A third-caster: spell slots start at 3rd character level and cap at 4th-level spells.

name: Weapon Bond
description: Ritual-bond up to two weapons (1 hour each). A bonded weapon can't be disarmed from you unless you're incapacitated, and you can summon it into your hand as a bonus action if it's on the same plane.

name: War Magic
description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Eldritch Strike
description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

name: Arcane Charge
description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, as part of that action.

name: Improved War Magic
description: When you use your action to cast a spell (not just a cantrip, per War Magic), you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Spellcasting (Arcane Trickster)
description: Cast wizard spells using INT, learned from the Wizard spell list (3 cantrips, then more per the class table). Most learned spells must be Enchantment or Illusion — spells picked at 8th, 14th, and 20th level can be from any school. A third-caster: spell slots start at 3rd character level and cap at 4th-level spells.

name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
description: Learn Mage Hand automatically (doesn't count against cantrips known); cast it as a bonus action, make its spectral hand invisible, and use it to stow/retrieve an item from a container or another creature, or pick a lock/disarm a trap remotely, all without provoking an attack of opportunity.

name: Magical Ambush
description: If you're hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, that creature has disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell this turn.

name: Versatile Trickster
description: As a bonus action while your Mage Hand is active, designate a creature within 5 feet of the hand — you gain advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of your turn.

name: Spell Thief
description: Reaction, immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area: force an INT save (your spell save DC). On a fail, negate the spell's effect on you and steal it — for 8 hours you can cast that spell (if you have slots/it's on your list) at its original level without expending a slot or material components; once per long rest.

name: Spellcasting
description: You must have thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand as a spellcasting focus when you cast any artificer spell (an infused item can also serve as a focus once you have Infuse Item). You know 2 cantrips at 1st level from the artificer spell list, gaining more at higher levels; you can swap one cantrip for another whenever you gain an artificer level. You prepare a number of artificer spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your artificer level rounded down (minimum 1), choosing from the artificer list; you can change your prepared list after a long rest. You can cast a prepared spell as a ritual if it has the ritual tag. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + INT modifier, spell attack bonus = proficiency bonus + INT modifier.

name: The Right Tool for the Job
description: With thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, you can magically create one set of artisan's tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. This creation requires 1 hour of uninterrupted work, which can coincide with a short or long rest. The tools are nonmagical, and they vanish the instant you use this feature again to create a different set.

name: Spell-Storing Item
description: You can touch one simple or martial weapon, or one item you can use as a spellcasting focus, and store a 1st- or 2nd-level spell in it that requires 1 action to cast (using a spell slot as normal). While holding the object, a creature can take an action to produce the spell's effect from it, using your spellcasting ability. The spell stays in the object until it's been cast from it a number of times equal to twice your Intelligence modifier (minimum twice), or until you use this feature again to store a different spell.

name: Magic Item Savant
description: You can attune to up to five magic items at once, and you ignore all class, race, spell, and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item.

name: Magic Item Master
description: You can attune to up to six magic items at once.

name: Soul of Artifice
description: You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws per magic item you are currently attuned to. If you're reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can use your reaction to end one of your artificer infusions, causing you to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.

name: Bardic Inspiration
description: As a bonus action, inspire another creature within 60 feet who can hear you: it gains one Bardic Inspiration die (a d6, increasing to d8 at 5th level, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th). Within the next 10 minutes, it can add the die to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes (rolled after the d20, before or after knowing the outcome) — the die is then lost even if unused. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once) per long rest.

name: Song of Rest
description: If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance spend Hit Dice to regain hit points at the end of a short rest, each of them regains an extra 1d6 hit points. The extra amount increases as you gain levels: 1d8 at 9th level, 1d10 at 13th, 1d12 at 17th. You must play music or sing for the duration of the short rest to grant this benefit — you can use any instrument you're proficient with, or your voice.

name: Spellcasting
description: You must have a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus to cast any cleric spell. You prepare a number of cleric spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your cleric level (minimum 1) — every spell on the cleric list is available to prepare, not just ones you've learned, and you can change your prepared list after a long rest. You can cast a prepared spell as a ritual if it has the ritual tag. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + WIS modifier, spell attack bonus = proficiency bonus + WIS modifier.

name: Divine Intervention improvement
description: Your Divine Intervention feature succeeds automatically — no roll required — any time you use it.

name: Spellcasting
description: You must have a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus to cast any druid spell. You prepare a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum 1) — every spell on the druid list is available to prepare, and you can change your prepared list after a long rest. You can cast a prepared spell as a ritual if it has the ritual tag. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + WIS modifier, spell attack bonus = proficiency bonus + WIS modifier.

name: Wild Shape
description: As an action, magically assume the shape of a beast you've seen before, provided it's of a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower and has no flying or swimming speed. You can stay in the shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down), or until you drop to 0 hit points, revert as a bonus action, or die. While shapeshifted you retain your own mind and Intelligence/Wisdom/Charisma scores, but take on the beast's other statistics (with some exceptions such as class features, saving throw/skill proficiencies, and Legendary Actions/Lair Actions); you can't cast spells (though you can still take other actions the form allows), and your gear either falls to the ground, melds into the new form, or (for worn items you choose) merges and stops functioning. Usable twice, regaining both uses on a long rest, or one use on a short rest.

name: Wild Shape improvement (CR 1/2, swim speed)
description: You can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1/2, and you can now transform into a beast with a swimming speed.

name: Wild Shape improvement (flying speed)
description: You can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1, and you can now transform into a beast with a flying speed.

name: Extra Attack (1)
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
description: Your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

name: Unarmored Movement improvement (vertical surfaces and liquids)
description: You gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.

name: Spellcasting
description: You must have a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus to cast any paladin spell. You prepare a number of paladin spells equal to your Charisma modifier + half your paladin level rounded down (minimum 1) — every spell on the paladin list is available to prepare, and you can change your prepared list after a long rest. You can cast a prepared spell as a ritual if it has the ritual tag. Charisma is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + CHA modifier, spell attack bonus = proficiency bonus + CHA modifier.

name: Aura improvements (30ft radius)
description: The range of your Aura of Protection and Aura of Courage (and any other paladin aura you have) increases from 10 feet to 30 feet.

name: Favored Enemy
description: Choose a type of favored enemy: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead — or, alternatively, choose two races of humanoid as your favored enemies. You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track your favored enemies, as well as on Intelligence checks to recall information about them. When you gain this feature, you also learn one language of your choice, typically one spoken by your favored enemy or its associates.

name: Natural Explorer
description: Choose one type of favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or the Underdark. While traveling for an hour or more in your favored terrain, you gain these benefits: difficult terrain doesn't slow your group's travel; your group can't become lost except by magical means; even when engaged in another activity while traveling (foraging, navigating, tracking) you remain alert to danger; if traveling alone, you can move stealthily at a normal pace; when you forage, you find twice as much food as normal; while tracking other creatures, you also learn their exact number, sizes, and how long ago they passed through the area.

name: Spellcasting
description: You know a limited number of ranger spells, chosen from the ranger spell list, per the ranger table (a fixed-known caster, not a prepared one) — you learn additional spells known as you gain ranger levels, and can swap one known spell for another whenever you gain a ranger level. You must have a druidic focus or component pouch as a spellcasting focus. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + WIS modifier, spell attack bonus = proficiency bonus + WIS modifier.

name: Favored Enemy improvement
description: You choose one additional favored enemy, and you learn one language of your choice, typically one spoken by that favored enemy or its associates.

name: Natural Explorer improvement
description: You choose one additional favored terrain.

name: Spellcasting
description: You must have an arcane focus or component pouch as a spellcasting focus to cast any sorcerer spell. You know a limited number of sorcerer spells, chosen from the sorcerer spell list, per the sorcerer table (a fixed-known caster) — you learn additional spells known as you gain sorcerer levels, and can swap one known spell for another whenever you gain a sorcerer level. Charisma is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + CHA modifier, spell attack bonus = proficiency bonus + CHA modifier.

name: Metamagic (3rd option)
description: You learn a third Metamagic option of your choice from among those available to sorcerers.

name: Metamagic (4th option)
description: You learn a fourth Metamagic option of your choice from among those available to sorcerers.

name: Spellcasting
description: You must have an arcane focus or component pouch as a spellcasting focus to cast any wizard spell. You prepare a number of wizard spells from your spellbook equal to your Intelligence modifier + your wizard level (minimum 1), and can change your prepared list after a long rest spent studying your spellbook. Unlike other prepared casters, you can cast a wizard spell as a ritual if it has the ritual tag and is in your spellbook, even if it isn't currently prepared. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + INT modifier, spell attack bonus = proficiency bonus + INT modifier.

name: Signature Spells
description: Choose two 3rd-level spells in your spellbook as your signature spells. You always have these two spells prepared, they don't count against the number of spells you have prepared, and you can cast each of them once at 3rd level without expending a spell slot. You must finish a short or long rest before you can cast either spell this way again.

name: Improved Critical (19-20)
description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

name: Superior Critical (18-20)
description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
description: As an action, imbue one weapon you're holding with positive energy for 1 minute. You add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1), it emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that, and it counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance/immunity to nonmagical attacks. Ends early if you let go of the weapon or fall unconscious.

name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
description: As an action, present your holy symbol and speak a prayer against fiends and undead. Each fiend or undead within 30 feet that can see or hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw, and on a failure is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage — a turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far from you as possible and can't willingly move within 30 feet of you, and it can't take reactions and can only use the Dash action or try to escape an effect preventing it from moving.

name: Aura of Devotion
description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

name: Purity of Spirit
description: You are always under the effects of a protection from evil and good spell.

name: Holy Nimbus
description: As an action, emanate an aura of sunlight for 1 minute: bright light in a 30-foot radius, dim light 30 feet beyond that. Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, it takes 10 radiant damage. You also gain advantage on saving throws against spells cast by fiends or undead while the nimbus is active. Usable once, regaining the ability on a long rest.

name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
description: As an action, present your holy symbol and force one creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw (a fiend or undead has disadvantage). On a failure, it's frightened for 1 minute or until it takes damage, and its speed is 0 while frightened this way. On a success, its speed is halved for 1 minute.

name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
description: As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 10 feet and gain advantage on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 hit points or falls unconscious.

name: Relentless Avenger
description: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after the attack and as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Soul of Vengeance
description: Whenever the creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature if it's within your reach.

name: Avenging Angel
description: As an action, transform for 1 hour: wings sprout from your back, granting a flying speed of 60 feet, and you emanate a 30-foot menacing aura while not incapacitated — a hostile creature that starts its turn there must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened of you for 1 minute (or until it takes damage). A frightened creature has disadvantage on saving throws against your paladin spells. Usable once, regaining the ability on a long rest.

name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
description: As an action, force each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature becomes frightened of you for 1 minute; a frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
description: When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after seeing the roll but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

name: Aura of Conquest
description: While you're not incapacitated, a menacing, magical aura extends 10 feet from you. Any creature frightened of you has its speed reduced to 0 while in the aura, and takes psychic damage equal to half your paladin level (rounded down) if it starts its turn there. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

name: Scornful Rebuke
description: Whenever a creature hits you with an attack while you're not incapacitated, that creature takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

name: Invincible Conqueror
description: As an action, become an avatar of conquest for 1 minute, gaining resistance to all damage; when you take the Attack action, you can make one additional attack as part of it; and your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. Usable once, regaining the ability on a long rest.

name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
description: As a bonus action, grant yourself a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for the next 10 minutes.

name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
description: Immediately after an attacker within 30 feet of you deals damage with an attack against a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt; on a success, it takes half as much damage.

name: Aura of the Guardian
description: Whenever a creature within 10 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically take that damage yourself instead — this doesn't reduce the damage, and you can't use this feature if you're incapacitated. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

name: Protective Spirit
description: If you end your turn in combat with fewer than half your hit points remaining and you aren't incapacitated, you regain hit points equal to 1d6 + half your paladin level.

name: Emissary of Redemption
description: You have resistance to all damage dealt to you by other creatures. Additionally, whenever a creature deals damage to you, it takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you took (rounded up). Neither benefit works against a creature you attack before your next turn, or (until the end of your next turn) against a creature that damages you and you don't forgive.

name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
description: As a bonus action, gain the following benefits for 10 minutes: advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks; you can carry, push, drag, or lift twice as much weight as normal; and the distance of your long and high jumps increases by 10 feet (no extra movement required).

name: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
description: Immediately after you use Divine Smite, you can channel residual energy into nearby allies. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you (including you) divide up a pool of temporary hit points equal to 2d8 + your paladin level, however you like, with no creature gaining more than half the total.

name: Aura of Alacrity
description: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet while you're not incapacitated. Additionally, when combat starts (or another creature enters this aura on its turn for the first time), that creature's walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of its turn if it's within 5 feet of you. At 18th level, the range at which allies gain this bonus increases to 10 feet.

name: Glorious Defense
description: When a creature you can see hits you or an ally within 10 feet with an attack, you can use your reaction to add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to the defender's AC for that attack, potentially causing it to miss. If it misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of this reaction, provided the attacker is within your weapon's range. Usable a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a long rest.

name: Living Legend
description: As a bonus action, gain the following benefits for 1 minute: advantage on Charisma checks; once per turn if you miss with a weapon attack you can cause it to hit instead; and if you fail a saving throw you can use your reaction to reroll it, with the second result used. Usable once, regaining the ability on a long rest or by expending a 5th-level spell slot (no action required).

name: Shield Master
description: If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to shove a creature within 5ft with your shield. If not incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Dexterity save against a spell or effect that targets only you. As a reaction, if subjected to an effect that lets you make a Dexterity save for half damage, you can take no damage on a success by interposing your shield.

name: Skilled
description: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Skulker
description: You can try to hide when only lightly obscured from the creature you're hiding from. Missing with a ranged weapon attack while hidden doesn't reveal your position. Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.

name: Spell Sniper
description: The range of spells you cast that require an attack roll is doubled. Your ranged spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover. Learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll, chosen from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list (spellcasting ability follows the list chosen).
prerequisite_note: The ability to cast at least one spell

name: Tavern Brawler
description: +1 STR or CON (max 20). Proficient with improvised weapons. Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage. When you hit with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

name: Tough
description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

name: Elemental Adept
description: Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of that type, and you can treat any 1 rolled on a damage die of that type as a 2. Can be selected multiple times, each time for a different damage type.
prerequisite_note: The ability to cast at least one spell

name: Weapon Master
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice, each a simple or martial weapon.

name: Artificer Initiate
description: Learn one cantrip and one 1st-level spell of your choice from the Artificer spell list (Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for them); the 1st-level spell can be cast once per long rest without expending a slot, and normally otherwise. Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools, usable as a spellcasting focus for any Intelligence-based spell you cast.

name: Chef
description: +1 CON or WIS (max 20). Gain proficiency with cook's utensils if you don't have it. As part of a short rest (with ingredients and cook's utensils on hand), cook food for up to 4 + your proficiency bonus creatures — any of them who spend Hit Dice to heal at the end of that rest regain an extra 1d8 hit points. With 1 hour of work or on finishing a long rest, cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus (usable within 8 hours); a creature can eat one as a bonus action to gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Crusher
description: +1 STR or CON (max 20). Once per turn, when you hit a creature no more than one size larger than you with bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5ft to an unoccupied space. When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage, attack rolls against that creature have advantage until the start of your next turn.

name: Eldritch Adept
description: Learn one Eldritch Invocation of your choice from the warlock class (choosing Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the ability tied to it; an invocation with its own prerequisites requires meeting them as if you were a warlock). Whenever you gain a level, you can swap the invocation for a different one from the warlock class.

name: Fighting Initiate
description: Learn one Fighting Style of your choice from the fighter class that you don't already have. Whenever you gain an Ability Score Improvement, you can swap it for a different fighter Fighting Style you don't know.

name: Gunner
description: +1 DEX (max 20). Gain proficiency with firearms. Ignore the loading property of firearms. Being within 5ft of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

name: Piercer
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a piercing-damage attack, you can reroll one of its damage dice and must use the new roll. On a critical hit that deals piercing damage, roll one additional damage die when determining the extra damage.

name: Poisoner
description: Ignore resistance to poison damage when you make a damage roll. Coating a weapon or piece of ammunition with poison takes a bonus action instead of an action. Gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit if you don't have it; with 1 hour and 50gp of materials, create a number of poison doses equal to your proficiency bonus. Applied poison keeps its potency for 1 minute or until you hit with the weapon/ammunition — a creature damaged by it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or take 2d8 poison damage and become poisoned until the end of your next turn.

name: Skill Expert
description: +1 to one ability score of your choice (max 20). Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Choose one skill you're proficient in (that doesn't already have its proficiency bonus doubled by another feature) and gain Expertise in it, doubling your proficiency bonus for checks with it.

name: Telekinetic
description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA (max 20). Learn the Mage Hand cantrip (castable without verbal or somatic components, its spectral hand can be made invisible; if you already knew it, its range increases by 30ft) — spellcasting ability is the one increased by this feat. As a bonus action, telekinetically shove one creature within 30ft: it must succeed on a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the increased ability's modifier) or be moved 5ft toward or away from you (a creature can willingly fail).

name: Telepathic
description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA (max 20). Speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60ft, in a language you know (it understands only if it knows that language too; it can't reply telepathically). Cast Detect Thoughts once per long rest without a slot or components (spellcasting ability is the one increased by this feat); can also cast it normally with a 2nd-level+ slot.

name: Dragon Fear
description: +1 STR, CON, or CHA (max 20). Instead of a normal breath weapon use, you can roar: each creature within 30ft that can see or hear you must succeed on a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + CHA modifier) or become frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save when it takes damage.

name: Dragon Hide
description: +1 STR, CON, or CHA (max 20). While unarmored, your AC can be calculated as 13 + Dexterity modifier (a shield can still be used). Grow retractable claws usable as natural weapons — unarmed strikes with them deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning.

name: Drow High Magic
description: Cast Detect Magic at will, without a spell slot. Cast Levitate and Dispel Magic each once per long rest without a slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these.

name: Dwarven Fortitude
description: +1 CON (max 20). Whenever you take the Dodge action, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself — roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain that many hit points.

name: Fey Teleportation
description: +1 INT or CHA (max 20). Learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. Learn the Misty Step spell (Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it), castable once without a spell slot, regaining the ability on a short or long rest.

name: Flames of Phlegethos
description: +1 INT or CHA (max 20). When you roll fire damage for a spell you cast, you can reroll any 1s on the fire damage dice (must keep the new roll). Whenever you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can wreathe yourself in harmless flames until the end of your next turn — they shed bright light 30ft/dim light 30ft further, and any creature within 5ft that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d4 fire damage.

name: Infernal Constitution
description: +1 CON (max 20). Resistance to cold and poison damage. Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

name: Orcish Fury
description: +1 STR or CON (max 20). When you hit with an attack using a simple or martial weapon, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice an extra time and add it as extra damage of the same type (once per short or long rest). Immediately after using Relentless Endurance, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack.

name: Prodigy
description: Gain one skill proficiency, one tool proficiency, and fluency in one language, all of your choice. Choose one skill you're already proficient in (that doesn't already have its proficiency bonus doubled by another feature) and gain Expertise in it.

name: Second Chance
description: +1 DEX, CON, or CHA (max 20). When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force it to reroll. Usable again only after you roll initiative or finish a short or long rest.

name: Squat Nimbleness
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). +5ft walking speed. Gain proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics (your choice). Advantage on Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to escape a grapple.

name: Wood Elf Magic
description: Learn one druid cantrip of your choice. Learn the Longstrider and Pass without Trace spells, each castable once per long rest without a spell slot; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Commander's Strike
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your attacks and use a bonus action to direct a friendly creature to strike. That creature can use its reaction to make one weapon attack, adding the superiority die to the damage roll.

name: Distracting Strike
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. Choose a creature within 5ft of the target other than yourself — that creature has advantage on its next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn.

name: Evasive Footwork
description: When you move, you can expend one superiority die, adding it to your AC until you stop moving.

name: Feinting Attack
description: As a bonus action, expend one superiority die and feint against a creature within 5ft. You have advantage on your next attack roll against that creature this turn, and if it hits, add the superiority die to the damage roll.

name: Goading Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. The target must make a Wisdom save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + STR or DEX modifier) or have disadvantage on any attack roll against a target other than you until the end of your next turn.

name: Lunging Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you make a melee weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to increase your reach for that attack by 5ft; if it hits, add the die to the damage roll.

name: Maneuvering Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. Then a friendly creature you can see can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.

name: Pushing Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. The target must make a STR save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + STR or DEX modifier) or be pushed up to 15ft away.

name: Rally
description: As a bonus action, expend one superiority die and choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you. That creature gains temporary hit points equal to the die roll plus your Charisma modifier.

name: Sweeping Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to damage another creature within 5ft of the original target and within your reach. Roll the superiority die; if the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the die roll (of the weapon's damage type).

name: Trip Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. The target must make a STR save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + STR or DEX modifier) or be knocked prone.

name: Resilient (Constitution)
description: Increase Constitution by 1 (max 20) and gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws. (Legacy per-ability entry predating the generic "Resilient" feat entry above, kept so existing characters whose feature is literally named this way still resolve a description by name.)
